subject: English
passage: To solve a Millennium Prize Problem, a mathematician must prove or disprove one of seven extraordinarily complex mathematical conjectures, each representing decades or centuries of unsolved work. ______ in 2003, when Grigori Perelman completed his proof of the Poincaré conjecture—considered one of the most challenging problems in topology—the mathematical community was left astounded.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. "Fittingly" logically signals that the information in this sentence—that the mathematical community was astounded when Perelman solved the Poincaré conjecture—describes a suitable or appropriate reaction to the completion of this extraordinarily difficult problem.
